data.title: The wall and the architect’s drawing
data.goal: The wall and the architect’s drawing

memoryNodes.cue: The wall is made of small building blocks.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 墙由小块建筑材料砌成。

memoryNodes.cue: A designer explains which features will stay.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 设计者解释哪些特征会保留。

memoryNodes.cue: The drawing separates exterior work from changes inside.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 图纸将外部工程与内部改动区分。

data.situation:
The visitors stopped outside the west wing. Its brick wall was warm in the morning light. An architect held up a drawing showing how the old windows would be repaired. Lin compared the drawing with the exterior of the building: the tall window openings were still there, although some frames were new. A small sign identified the original architectural features. Lin: Are you trying to make it look exactly as it did before?
Architect: We want the old architecture to remain visible while the building works for its new use. These external walls will stay. Inside, some spaces need to change.
Jo: That is why the drawings show old and new parts in different colours. Window display
Original opening: retained
Damaged frame: replaced
External wall: repaired
Please compare the drawing with the window above this label.

Lin compared the drawing with the exterior of the building: the tall window openings were still there, although some frames were new. A small sign identified the original architectural features.
readingBlocks.zh: 访客在西翼外停下。砖墙在晨光里显得暖和。一位建筑师举起图纸，说明旧窗将怎样修复。林把图纸与建筑外部比较：高大的窗洞仍在，不过有些窗框是新的。小标牌指出原有的建筑特征。

readingBlocks.en:
Lin: Are you trying to make it look exactly as it did before?
Architect: We want the old architecture to remain visible while the building works for its new use. These external walls will stay. Inside, some spaces need to change.
Jo: That is why the drawings show old and new parts in different colours.
readingBlocks.zh:
林：您想让它看起来和从前完全一样吗？
建筑师：我们希望旧建筑的风格仍看得出来，同时满足新的用途。这些外墙会保留，里面有些空间需要改变。
乔：因此图纸用不同颜色标出新旧部分。
